spans.s:
f. (-षा)
Desire to take or lead.
E.
णी to lead, desid. form, affix अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous to take or lead.
E.
णी to lead, desid. form, उ aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Reproachful, abusive, scurrilous, censorious.
E.
निदि to abuse, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दन्ती-न्दत्)
Abusing, blaming.
E.
निन्द to blame, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Having a maimed or defective hand: it is also sometimes read निम्नतल.

n. (-नं)
Reproach, censure, blame.
E.
णिद to reprove, affix ल्यट्.

f. (-न्दा)
1 Censure, reproach, reproof, blame, abuse, reviling.
2 Injury, injuring.
3 Wickedness.
E.
णिद to abuse, &c. affixes अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-तिः)
Irony, ironical praise.
E.
निन्दा censure, and स्तुति praise.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षु)
Wishing to kill.
E.
नि before णश to destroy, desid. v., उ affix, form irr.

m. (-दः)
Sound in general.
E.
नि before नद to sound, affix अप्; also निनाद.

m. (-दः)
Sound in general.
E.
नि before नद to sound, affix घञ्; also निनद.

n. (-नं)
Engaging in performance. नि before णी to lead, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded.
E.
नि before नद to sound, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Abused, reviled, reproved.
2 Low, despicable, worthy of being reviled.
3 Prohibited, forbidden.
E.
णिद to abuse, affix क्त.

f. (-न्दुः)
A woman bearing a dead child.
E.
णिदि to abuse, affix डु.

mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं)
Bad, vile, despicable, reprehensible.
E.
निन्दा, and यत् aff.
